_comment: Rotation state for the hourly GIF series. styles.tabloid: tabloid_kit.py — 600x780 newsprint front page that assembles, then STOP PRESS (generalized from tyler_01_enquirer.py; see alex_01_register.py for usage)
styles.meme: meme_kit.py — 640x640, real quotes stamped onto stock meme templates fetched live from api.memegen.link, reeled into a slideshow with a closing stinger. Needs network access at render time, unlike the other two kits.

rules: Every headline and pull-quote must be verbatim from the graph — never invent a fact.
Verify source quotes; graphiti's entity summaries contain extraction errors.
Skip anything that could actually harm the subject (confidential-data handling, misconduct, health, immigration risk).
Do not name private third parties who are unnamed in the graph.
Vary the visual style; rotate tabloid -> ballad -> meme -> tabloid -> ... rather than reusing the last one used.
